comment: Map port names (us-4.2; the C# port of engine/mapgen.js, model/floorplan.js, engine/actmap.js). Regenerated by Tools/map-keys.mjs from the aliases MK./MV./MM. in Ashen.Domain.Map; names CombatKeys/CombatValues already own are reused, never duplicated.

keySets.name: MapKeys
keySets.doc: Keys of map graphs, map configs, run history rows, oracle table dumps and rules/mapEngine.json the map port reads (shipped wire names).

keySets.name: MapValues
keySets.doc: Closed map values: refusal key templates ({0} slots), separators and typeof names.

keySets.name: MapMessages
keySets.doc: Map port error messages (developer-facing; {0}.. are string.Format slots).

keys.AnchorFloorRange: floor {0} is outside this act's rollable band 1..{1} (floors: {2})
keys.AnchorNotObject: anchor must be an object like {{ at: 'fraction', of: 0.5 }}, got {0}
keys.BossNoEncounter: Boss destination '{0}' has no valid encounter for seat '{1}' at tier {2}
keys.BossNotBossNode: Boss destination '{0}' is not a boss node
keys.BuildNoBoss: buildActMap: seat '{0}' has no boss encounters
keys.BuildSeatRequired: buildActMap: a seat id is required, got '{0}' (SPEC §13.2)
keys.BuildShapeRefused: buildActMap: this run's map shape does not resolve — {0}
keys.BuildTierInvalid: buildActMap: tier must be a positive integer, got {0}
keys.CountInvalid: must be a non-negative integer, got {0}
keys.CountRenamed: renamed to '{0}' — it counts nodes in the whole graph, never reachability, and the old name promised the second
keys.DestinationsDoNotFit: Boss destinations must fit the map columns
keys.DestinationsNeedRest: Map needs its pre-boss rest and terminal
keys.DestinationsNotUnique: Boss destinations must have unique encounter IDs
keys.FixedCollision: {0} resolves to floor {1}, which "{2}" already claims
keys.FixedEliteNoRest: a fixed Elite on floor {0} has no floor below it that can hold the promised rest (a fixed rank bypasses noEliteBefore, so restBeforeElite cannot be kept). Fix a Shrine rank below floor {0}, or open noShrineBefore above it.
keys.FixedEntryNotObject: must be an object like {{ at: 'first', type: 'monster' }}
keys.FixedEntryType: {0} is not a node type — one of {1}
keys.FixedNotArray: must be an array of {{ at, type }} anchors, got {0}
keys.FloorRulesDoNotResolve: mapgen: this act's floor rules do not resolve — {0}
keys.FloorRulesMissing: missing — an act with no floor rules is not a default, it is an unauthored map
keys.GatePastBand: resolves to {0}, past the last rollable floor {1} — no floor could ever hold {2}
keys.LegacyGate: split into 'noShrineBefore' and 'noEliteBefore' — one anchor could not put a rest earlier than the first Elite, which is what the rest-before-Elite promise needs
keys.NoEncountersInPool: No encounters in pool '{0}' for seat '{1}'
keys.NoRollableFloor: act has {0} floor(s); no floor is rollable
keys.RestNotBoolean: must be true or false, got {0}
keys.RestUnsatisfiable: no floor can hold the promised rest: Shrines start at {0}, Elites at {1}, and every floor between is barred (noShrineOn {2}) or claimed by a fixed rank that is not itself a Shrine. Open noShrineBefore earlier, push noEliteBefore later, or fix a Shrine rank below the Elite gate.
keys.RollEncounterSeatRequired: rollEncounter: a seat id is required (SPEC §13.2)
keys.ShapeColumnsWhy: {0} columns is the floor — one column is a corridor: every walker lands on the same node and the act has no choices in it
keys.ShapeFloorsNone: this act has no viable length
keys.ShapeFloorsWhy: {0} is the shortest act this act's own floor rules resolve at (ask tools/mapplan.mjs --floors {1} and read the collision)
keys.ShapeNoViableLength: no act length from {0} to {1} resolves this act's floor rules
keys.ShapeNoWeights: this act authors no typeWeights, so there is nothing to re-weight
keys.ShapeNotObject: must be an object like {{ floors: 8, columns: 5, typeWeights: {{ elite: 30 }} }}, got {0}
keys.ShapeNotWhole: must be a whole number of {0}, got {1}
keys.ShapeUnknownKnob: is not a run-shape knob — one of {0}
keys.ShapeWeightAboveMax: {0} is above the {1} a run-shape knob may set
keys.ShapeWeightInvalid: must be a weight of 0 or more, got {0}
keys.ShapeWeightUnknown: is not a node type this act rolls — one of {0}
keys.ShapeWeightsNotObject: must be an object of node type -> weight, got {0}
keys.ShapeWeightsZero: every weight is zero — no type could ever be rolled and every node would fall back to Monster. Raise at least one above zero.
keys.UnknownWeightsMissing: missing — resolveUnknownNode requires it, so its absence is a crash at act build, not a default
keys.UnknownWeightsNotObject: must be an object of kind -> weight, got {0}
keys.UnknownWeightsZero: weights sum to 0 — every `?` node would resolve to the first key

numberSets.name: MapNumbers
numberSets.doc: Arithmetic constants of the map rules (definitions, not tuning): the sweepSeed multiplier (Knuth) and the uint32 width for ToInt32.
